items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Tootie used to take down dictation from Joe Moore/ who was blind.

ctx.x: this, Tootie got involved and Tootie was interested in writing, as I was. Tootie used to take down dictation from Joe Moore/ who was blind. Joe on the piano would tell him what notes to put where and who to give it to. He'd hear all this and Tootie learned to write this way.

At one point we decided we were going to take some lessons and we both went to an old style--I wouldn't call him a martinette, but a very rigid instrucoor type that Billie Fisher had and his name was (inaudible). That began the whole thing of studying. Tootie did it too.
